body_sections.Summary: Alinta/AGL Joint Merger Proposal reflecting the Mergers Implementation Agreement (MIA) signed between the parties.  On 3rd August 2006, the ACCC accepted undertakings from Alinta in relation to this proposal. As part of the processes under the undertakings, the ACCC subsequently assessed whether it was necessary for Alinta to divest the Agility contracts associated with the Moomba to Sydney and Parmelia Gas Pipelines. On 26 September 2006 the ACCC determined that it was necessary for Alinta to divest the Agility contracts.
